text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The way you eat is so cute, Inari. It's<n>like you're a
squirrel or something! ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Who're you callin' a squirrel?! I'm<n>proud to be an
Umamusume and<n>wouldn't have it any other way!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I know! Go on, eat up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Although I guess if I'm being honest,<n>I wouldn't
mind a bit more dessert...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! I'm tryin' to look after<n>myself. There's no
way I'm gonna<n>cave into temptations!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: No matter how tall I get, I refuse to get<n>any wider!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up? Why're you so<n>quiet all of the
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I think I'll start running in the morning<n>for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek's dedication to running<n>tightens up her
abs.
